requirements.description: Service Provider shall replace any individual deemed a security risk to the Bank within three (3) business days of receiving written notice, whether prior notice is provided or notice is provided immediately after removal.
requirements.evidence: Replacement personnel provided within three business days; written notice of security risk determination

source_refs.excerpt: If, in the opinion of the Bank, an individual is deemed to present a security risk to the Bank, notice will be provided to the Service Provider, if possible, prior to the individual being immediately escorted from the Bank's premises. If it is not possible to provide prior notice, that notice will be provided immediately thereafter. At the Bank's request, the Service Provider shall replace the individual in regard to the provision of the Services within three (3) business days of receiving this written notice.
